messages:
Mike: quick sync — re: the rollback yesterday, i want to propose a small playbook for a "mini-canary" that reduces blast radius.
Jess: agree. the pattern looked like a config toggle leaked to 2% of traffic then ramped. we need both sampling + auto-fallback.
Sara: can we keep the sample scope to account tags and org tiers? limiting to `tag:beta` would cut exposure.
Ana: +1. also suggest a hard token-based cap so a bad prompt flood doesn't amplify impact.
Mike: concrete suggestions: 1) per-flag scoped sampling (by tag) 2) auto-rollback on error-rate >= 10% for 3m 3) gradual ramp timers (10m steps) 4) emergency quarantine button.
Jess: for auto-rollback, we need a lightweight detector that watches regression-class signals (5xx, latency p95 increase, decayed success metric). We should avoid noisy rollbacks.
Sara: propose these thresholds: 5xx rate > 3% OR p95 latency up 2x OR error budget burn > 30% in 5m -> trigger canary pause + notify.
Ana: i can own the detector logic and the playbook text. ETA: two weeks.
Mike: assign ownership in thread: Ana -> detector + alerting; Jess -> rollout timing defaults and simulator; Sara -> flag scoping patterns + default tag mapping.
Jess: i'll add a small sim harness to test scenarios — will add `scripts/canary_sim.sh` that runs traffic mixes and asserts thresholds.
Sara: need a new field in the flag schema: `sample_scope` with values [global, org_tag, cohort_id]. small change. i'll open PR.
deploy-bot: [deploy-check] Canary gate rule set v0.1 validated against staging clusters. CI: green.
Mike: action items (short):
- Ana: detector prototype + docs (due 2025-05-09)
- Jess: simulator + testcases (due 2025-05-07)
- Sara: PR for flag schema & migration notes (due 2025-05-05)
- Mike: add emergency quarantine button in console + runbook (due 2025-05-12)
Jess: i recommend we add a periodic audit (monthly) to scan for flags that are global but should be scoped. put that on rotation.
Sara: recurring incidents note — we saw same cascade 3x in last 9 months: pattern = unscoped flag + traffic spike + missing fallback. recommend a metric: ‘flag_exposure_count’ per deploy and alert if >1 for a week.
Ana: will include regression tests to detect config leaks in CI: sample flags should not default to global in templates.
Mike: ops question — how do we avoid noisy alerts? can we implement a two-tier alert: page on major + slack on minor?
Jess: yes. major = auto-rollback triggered (page), minor = canary paused / policy violated (slack). Ops runbook will define thresholds.
Sara: can we add a short example snippet for guard rule?:
```
# example guard rule
{ "scope": "org_tag", "tag": "beta", "sample_pct": 2, "auto_rollback": { "error_rate_pct": 3, "window_mins": 3 } }
```
Ana: sweet. i'll draft a one-pager and link it from the postmortem follow-ups doc.
Mike: link to new doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/canary-mini-playbook (WIP)
Jess: timeline check — we should ship minimal detector + schema change first (low-risk), then simulator, then console button. canary labels: `mini` vs `wide`.
Sara: +1 — staging rollout plan: enable `mini` for 5 internal customers for 2 weeks before wider opt-in.
Mike: last bit — ownership handoff: Ana will own rollout signal SLOs; Jess will own simulation and gating infra; Sara will own flag schema and migration. i'll follow up with calendar invites for check-ins.
Ana: ack. i'll create a tracker card in the postmortem board: PM-4321-mini-canary-playbook and add owners + dates.
Jess: tagging remediation pattern as "flag-surge" in the incident tracker so we can query historical runs.
Sara: one more: we should add a dashboard: canary_phased_exposure with time series for sample_pct, error_rate, rollback_events. i'll sketch it.
Mike: thanks all. next check-in in 7 days. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: [reminder] PM-4321 card created by Ana.
